passage:
A documentary showed different funeral practices, including green burials that use fewer materials and allow the body to return naturally to the earth.
Students were quiet after watching it. The topic felt serious, but the teacher said every culture has ways of dealing with death, memory, and respect.
The class discussed how environmental thinking can affect even the final parts of life.
Some students felt uncomfortable. Others found the idea peaceful.
The lesson was not about choosing one practice. It was about seeing that values shape rituals. How people say goodbye reflects what they believe about life, nature, and responsibility.
